instruction: Candid medium-full documentary photograph of a couple walking in a bright indoor garden atrium. On the left, the woman in the white hijab and dress (R2) walks forward, looking at her partner. On the right, the man in the white shirt and light blue jeans (R1) walks beside her, smiling. They hold hands in the center. The background is softly blurred with green foliage under bright, natural light.
